item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
• Better suggestions: a new on-device engine that searches whole phrases, so suggestions are right more often and run longer.
  • Tab accepts the next word, ⇧Tab accepts the whole suggestion, and ⌥Tab types a real Tab.
  • Suggestions take the conversation on screen into account, and the next one is ready before you press Tab again.
  • OneMemory can learn from what you write (redacted, with the same retention and forget controls as captures), with its own switch in Settings.
  • Phone numbers are suggested whole, and names and jargon you use aren't treated as misspellings.
  • No suggestions in search boxes and small fields, and long suggestions wrap within the field.
  • Model downloads resume after a lost connection or a quit, and are verified before use.
  • The app opens without the "Apple could not verify OneMemory" warning when copied out of the DMG offline.

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
• OneMemory now updates itself. It checks for new versions in the background; you can also choose Check for Updates… from the menu bar, or turn automatic checks off in Settings › General.
  • New About section in Settings, with the version, licence and acknowledgements, and an About OneMemory item in the menu.
